title: TPX
description: A fully configurable teleportation server-side mod.
body:
A highly configurable teleportation server-side mod that combines homes, warps, teleport requests, random teleports, death recovery, spawn commands, and more into a single package.

Designed for both players and server owners, every major feature can be customized through the config, allowing you to control cooldowns, warmups, permissions, costs, sounds, particles, and much more without requiring additional addons or dependencies.
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54cbdce7e0d129285d366f3167f3f42ff146ad22_0.webp)
*   Teleport Requests
*   Teleport Here Requests
*   Homes
*   Favorite Homes
*   Home Sharing
*   Warps
*   Spawn
*   Back
*   Random Teleport
*   Death Point
*   Player Settings Menu
*   Sounds & Particles
*   Cooldowns & Warmups
*   XP Costs
*   Permission Support

Nearly every feature can be configured to fit your server's needs.

Disable what you don't want and customize the rest.
*   Cooldowns
*   Warmups
*   XP Costs
*   Permissions
*   Sounds
*   Particles
*   Messages

_**More versions will be supported in the future!**_
